hook.text: Two delivery specialists carry a refrigerator into your kitchen, unbox it, and haul the old one away.

buildup.text: White-glove delivery includes room-of-choice placement, assembly, installation, and packaging removal.

discovery.text: It transforms delivery from a logistics task into a customer experience that drives loyalty and reviews.

twist.text: It costs 5–10x more than doorstep delivery. Training, scheduling, and liability add up fast.

climax.text: Furniture and appliance brands that offer white-glove see 40% fewer returns and higher satisfaction.

punchline.text: Deliver the experience, not just the product.
